Joshua.title: Joshua
Joshua.question: Will courage remain rooted in instruction rather than conquest for its own sake?

chapters.title: Be Strong
chapters.game: Meditate on the instruction before crossing.

chapters.title: Rahab and the Spies
chapters.game: Hide the scouts and mark the scarlet cord.

chapters.title: Crossing Jordan
chapters.game: Carry twelve memorial stones from the riverbed.

chapters.title: Jericho
chapters.game: March the pattern, sound the trumpets, protect Rahab.

chapters.title: Achan’s Hidden Goods
chapters.game: Trace the community’s loss to the buried objects.

chapters.title: Ai
chapters.game: Set the ambush without repeating earlier presumption.

chapters.title: The Gibeonites
chapters.game: Inspect the worn supplies and face a rushed oath.

chapters.title: Choose This Day
chapters.game: Place household stones beside the covenant witness.
